Question: Let \[ \begin{gathered} f(x)=\log_{10}\big(\sin(\pi x) \\ {}\cdot\sin(2\pi x)\cdot\sin(3\pi x) \\ {}\cdot\sin(4\pi x)\cdot\sin(5\pi x) \\ {}\cdot\sin(6\pi x)\cdot\sin(7\pi x) \\ {}\cdot\sin(8\pi x)\big). \end{gathered} \] The intersection of the domain of \(f(x)\) with the interval \([0,1]\) is a union of \(n\) disjoint open intervals. What is \(n?\)
